subject: SUM clause
notes: kb/Work PB1294 landed. The value a rolled addition adds is the entry's sum counter occurrence (a ReportSumCounterPlace read) or the operand of its SOURCE or VALUE clause as a number (BindRolledValues); a counter's additions precede its being read because registrations on one group are put in dependency order (RegisterCrossEngineAdditions). Witnessed by a detail -> control footing -> FINAL footing chain, a VALUE entry, an unprintable SOURCE entry and a SOURCE operand that is a VARYING counter (4+6+8 = 18).
